statement: The paper proposes a #QBF proof system Q-MICE based on the #SAT proof system MICE [10] and proves that it is exponentially stronger than the naive (Section 3) and ∀Exp+MICE proof systems (Section 3.1). In fact we observe that Q-MICE is capable of certifying all the rules of d4-QBF [8] except the decomposition rule. However, Q-MICE is modular, in the sense that, based on the requirements, one can always add more sound #QBF inference rules like the decomposition rule from [8]. The challenge of doubly exponential solutions may be mitigated in Q-MICE by representing integers by arithmetic circuits. An immediate open problem is to establish a genuine lower bound [3] for Q-MICE. We conjecture that the propositional XOR-PAIRS (which are hard for MICE [5]) would be hard for Q-MICE but it is not a genuine lower bound. Another open problem is to extend other #SAT proof systems for #QBF.
